title: Add admin-backed training settings proxy and config import/export
description: Problem: operators can reach the Training Workbench but cannot directly edit the training settings needed to launch and benchmark runs from that page. Model-related training values such as active/fallback training tags are also not exposed in the central Admin Configuration surface. Desired outcome: keep Admin Configuration as the single source of truth for editable settings while allowing admin-only local proxies such as the Training Workbench to edit the same underlying values, with first-pass searchable training-setting selection, last-used persistence, and import/export affordances for training/general config slices.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from operator feedback after the first training workbench pass: the route was admin-only, but launch-critical settings still required a detour into the generic Admin Configuration surface and some training values were not exposed there at all.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Implemented an admin-backed training settings proxy directly in `TrainingWorkbench.razor` using `AdminSettingsService`, including searchable setting selection, last-used persistence via local storage, selected/all training-setting save flows, and training-scope import/export text transfer. Central admin config was extended to expose `MemorySmith:Training:ActiveModelTag` and `MemorySmith:Training:FallbackModelTag`, and Admin Configuration gained general import/export plus Save Visible/Save All split with tooltips.
